judgment.rationale: The manifest preserves all nine required columns and correctly includes all three orders, customers, weights, shipping methods, item details, and costs. Freight uses the operative approved record-17 rate of $150 rather than the unapproved $110 draft. Savings formulas yield $2.00, $75.00, and $4.99. Total formulas correctly yield 302.5 lb, $230.95 shipment cost, $312.94 industry-average cost, and $81.99 savings. Tracking numbers are appropriately left blank with an explanatory note. Source rate-band gaps do not affect these shipments.
